title: KB Vellaznimi win Liga e Pare
description: KB Vellaznimi have won Liga e Pare and would return to the SuperLeague for the next season. In the Final game they edged Prishtina e Re 76-65. Michael Green (190-G, college: MVSU) led the way with 33 points and Bardh Rexha (191-G-2001) netted 12. Ujkan Karanezi (202-SF-1995) posted 11, whilst Atik Koshi (189-G-1999) had 9. Dion Haxhosaj (206-C/F-1998) replied with 24 points in a loss and Arti Islamaj (G/F) produced 13.
